adjudication.rationale: In handleCancelBooking.ts the new logic iterates calendar references and, when the referenced credentialId is not found in bookingToDelete.user.credentials, it falls back to `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId } })` and then uses that credential with `getCalendar(calendarCredential)` to perform `calendar?.deleteEvent(...)`. The diff shows no validation that the fetched credential belongs to the booking’s user/host/team (e.g., matching userId/teamId) and no check of `invalid` before using it. This is a verifiable behavior change from the prior code (which only used a credential present on the user object) and could lead to acting on a credential unrelated to the booking if the stored reference points to an unexpected credentialId.
